description: Read an owned Meta ad account’s status, currency, timezone, spend and funding display. Money includes major amounts and raw minor-unit strings. Includes the read-only metaEdits enabled setting and approval rule, plus permissions (visible, read, launch and edit as off, approval or allowed, approvalRule) from the Account Permissions page; CLI/MCP cannot change them. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.
name: ads_get_account
title: Read Account Details
